_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: Siz Golf o'ynayapsiz - O'yinchi {player_id}. Maqsad: Ushbu turda eng past umumiy ballni oling. Agar ustunlar bir xil qiymatga ega bo'lsa, ular 0 ga teng. Kartaning qiymatlari: A = 1, 2-10 = nomli qiymat, J / Q = 10, K = 0 Harakatlar (to'g'ri qavslardan foydalaning): - '[draw]' - Qadamdan chizish - '[take]' - Chiqilgan to'plamdan olish - '[swap X Y]' - X (satr) Y (ustun) bilan chizilgan kartani almashtirish - '[discard]' - Chiqilgan kartani tashlash

board.drew: Siz chizgan: {card} Endi siz [swap X Y] yoki [discard] bo'lishingiz kerak.
board.took: Siz: {card} chiqindi to'plamidan olib qo'ydingiz Siz u bilan [swap X Y] olishingiz kerak (chiqarish mumkin emas).

options.final_turns: Yakuniy burilishlar! Sizning tanlovingiz: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Siz: [swap X Y] (qopqoqdan kartalarni tashlab boʻlmaydi)
options.swap_or_discard: Siz quyidagilarni bajarishingiz kerak: [swap X Y] yoki [discard]

action_desc.swapped: O'yinchi {pid} o'rniga {new} o'yinchi bilan {old} o'yinchi almashdi ({row},{col})

message.knocked: O'yinchi {pid} zarba berdi! Har bir boshqa o'yinchi yana bir turn oladi.
message.final_round: O'yinchi {pid} {reason}! Har bir o'yinchi yana bir marta o'tadi.

invalid.wrong_action: To'g'ri BIR qavsli amalni ishlating: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock] yoki [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Siz tashlab yuborilgan kartani tashlab yuborolmaysiz. Siz uni almashtirishingiz kerak.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Sizda kartangiz bor. Siz uni [swap X Y] yoki [discard] qilishingiz kerak.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: O'zgartirish uchun sizga kartani chizish kerak.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Sizni tashlash uchun sizga kartadan foydalanish kerak.
invalid.knock_with_card: Siz chizilgan karta bilan taqillatolmaysiz. Avval o'z navbatingizni yakunlang.

summary.full: O'yin tugadi! O'yinchi {winner} g'olib bo'ladi va {score} ball to'plagan bo'ladi! Yakuniy natijalar: {scores}
